description:
Training for a triathlon, a marathon or a gran fondo? SharpIt builds your week toward race day, rereads it every morning against what your watch measured, and repairs it when you miss a session.

Connected to Apple Health, Garmin, Strava and Withings.

One decision every morning
A verdict, three reasons at most, a confidence level. SharpIt reads your night and your load, then tells you whether today's session holds or gets lighter. Nothing changes without your OK.

A plan built toward your race
Two or three key sessions a week. Miss the rest and the plan holds. Missed a session? SharpIt reshuffles the end of your week and waits for your OK.

17 checks before every session
The coach proposes, 17 fixed rules verify. A session too hard for your week doesn't get through.

Compared to you, not to an average
Your numbers are read against your own baseline. A small dip triggers nothing. A real one, you'll know.

Stored in Europe, never on iCloud, never sold. Export or delete your account from the app.

Free: your log and all your data. Free: the morning proposal. SharpIt Pro: the plan toward your race, the coach and the analyses.

SharpIt Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) that you can cancel at any time from your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use: https://sharpit.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sharpit.app/privacy
promotionalText: A coach that reads your night, your load and your plan every morning, and tells you what today's session should be.
